reasons.detail: R1 — `checkSpecJson()` now emits one `requirements[N].priority` issue per requirement missing or null priority when `requirements.length > 3`, including requirement id in the message.
R3 — `checkSpecJson()` now emits one `tasks[N].test_strategy` issue per task with missing/null/whitespace test strategy, including task id in the message.

R2 — `checkSpecJson()` now only flags missing/null `requirements[n].priority` (len>3 gate), while empty/invalid/non-string priorities are not handled there and thus remain schema-validation failures in `validateSpecJsonObject()`.

R4 — `test_strategy` validation is executed only inside `Array.isArray(spec.tasks)` in `checkSpecJson`, while existing missing/empty task checks remain unchanged as verified by added tests for both undefined and empty `tasks` arrays.

R5 — The diff introduces explicit R5 coverage for mechanical prechecks before skip-guardrail/guardrail evaluation, enforces structural issues take precedence, verifies no issue-log mutation, and adds schema-boundary + spec-guardrail-definition tests, which collectively preserve the required run-order and semantics.

R6 — The diff preserves existing checkSpecJson structural guards for unresolved markers/empty core fields and task validation depth, while adding explicit tests that assert those same behaviors plus validateTestHeaders coverage semantics remain intact.
